note: Why sha256 changed (2026-11-20): capturedSha256 is the SHA-256 of this prompt's text with the trailing spaces cut from 2 line ends (line 4 (2 spaces), line 10 (1 space)) and without the file's final newline; hashing that form of the saved file reproduces it exactly. sha256 is now the SHA-256 of the file bytes, which keep those spaces and the final newline.
